tools.name: send_campaign_test_and_archive_draft
tools.description: Sends a test version of a draft campaign to a list of seed email addresses, then moves the draft file from the drafts folder to the tested folder. Also reads the draft's HTML and subject from disk.

params.name: draft_name
params.description: File name of the draft campaign JSON in the drafts folder

params.name: seed_emails
params.description: Email addresses that should receive the test send

tools.code:
import json
import shutil
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage
from pathlib import Path

from agents import function_tool

DRAFTS_DIR = Path("/var/campaigns/drafts")
TESTED_DIR = Path("/var/campaigns/tested")
SMTP_HOST = "smtp.internal.example.com"


def _build_message(subject, html, recipient):
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["Subject"] = "[TEST] " + subject
    msg["From"] = "marketing@example.com"
    msg["To"] = recipient
    msg.set_content("This email requires an HTML capable client.")
    msg.add_alternative(html, subtype="html")
    return msg


@function_tool
def send_campaign_test_and_archive_draft(draft_name: str, seed_emails: list[str]) -> str:
    source_path = DRAFTS_DIR / draft_name
    if not source_path.exists():
        return f"Draft {draft_name} not found"
    data = json.loads(source_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    sent = 0
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, 587) as server:
        server.starttls()
        for address in seed_emails:
            server.send_message(_build_message(data["subject"], data["html"], address))
            sent += 1
    TESTED_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    destination = TESTED_DIR / draft_name
    shutil.move(str(source_path), str(destination))
    return f"Sent {sent} test emails and moved draft to {destination}"

tools.name: move_subscribers_to_segment
tools.description: Moves subscribers from one audience segment to another and records the change in the segment history. Updates the subscriber rows in the database.

params.name: source_segment
params.description: Name of the segment to move subscribers out of

params.name: target_segment
params.description: Name of the segment to move subscribers into

params.name: min_engagement_score
params.description: Only move subscribers with an engagement score at or below this value

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("email-marketing")
DB_PATH = "marketing.db"


@mcp.tool()
def move_subscribers_to_segment(source_segment: str, target_segment: str, min_engagement_score: int) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        cur = conn.cursor()
        rows = cur.execute(
            "SELECT id FROM subscribers WHERE segment = ? AND engagement_score <= ?",
            (source_segment, min_engagement_score),
        ).fetchall()
        ids = [r[0] for r in rows]
        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        for sub_id in ids:
            cur.execute("UPDATE subscribers SET segment = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?", (target_segment, now, sub_id))
            cur.execute(
                "INSERT INTO segment_history (subscriber_id, from_segment, to_segment, changed_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (sub_id, source_segment, target_segment, now),
            )
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    result = {
        "moved_count": len(ids),
        "from": source_segment,
        "to": target_segment,
        "changed_at": now,
    }
    return result

tools.name: purchase_sms_credits_and_run_warmup
tools.description: Checks the current sending credit balance, charges the account card for an email credit package, and starts the IP warmup job for the new sending volume.

params.name: credit_package_id
params.description: Identifier of the credit package to buy

tools.code:
import subprocess

import requests
import stripe
from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def purchase_sms_credits_and_run_warmup(credit_package_id: str, customer_id: str) -> str:
    current_credit_balance_response = requests.get("https://api.mailer.example.com/v1/credits", timeout=10)
    current_credit_balance_amount = current_credit_balance_response.json()["balance"]
    package_price_in_cents_for_selected_package = {"small": 5000, "medium": 20000, "large": 75000}[credit_package_id]
    payment_intent_for_credit_purchase = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=package_price_in_cents_for_selected_package,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        confirm=True,
        metadata={"package": credit_package_id},
    )
    warmup_process_completed_result = subprocess.run(
        ["python", "scripts/ip_warmup.py", "--package", credit_package_id],
        capture_output=True, text=True,
    )
    return f"Balance was {current_credit_balance_amount}, payment {payment_intent_for_credit_purchase.id}, warmup exit {warmup_process_completed_result.returncode}"

tools.name: share_campaign_workspace_with_agency
tools.description: Grants an agency user editor or viewer access to a campaign, moves the campaign into the agency's shared folder, and emails an invite. Reads the campaign record first.

params.name: campaign_id
params.description: ID of the campaign to share

params.name: agency_email
params.description: Email address of the agency user receiving access

params.name: role
params.description: Access level to grant: editor or viewer

params.name: shared_folder_id
params.description: ID of the shared folder to move the campaign into

import sqlite3
import secrets
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

import requests
from agents import function_tool

DB_PATH = "marketing.db"
INVITE_API = "https://api.mailer.example.com/v1/invites"


@function_tool
def share_campaign_workspace_with_agency(campaign_id: int, agency_email: str, role: str, shared_folder_id: int) -> str:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    cur = conn.cursor()
    campaign_row = cur.execute(
        "SELECT name, folder_id, owner_id FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?", (campaign_id,)
    ).fetchone()
    campaign_name, previous_folder_id, owner_id = campaign_row
    user_row = cur.execute("SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = ?", (agency_email,)).fetchone()
    user_id = user_row[0]
    token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    expires_at = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(days=7)).isoformat()
    cur.execute(
        "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO campaign_permissions (campaign_id, user_id, role, granted_by) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (campaign_id, user_id, role, owner_id),
    )
    cur.execute(
        "INSERT INTO access_tokens (campaign_id, user_id, token, expires_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (campaign_id, user_id, token, expires_at),
    )
    cur.execute("UPDATE campaigns SET folder_id = ? WHERE id = ?", (shared_folder_id, campaign_id))
    cur.execute(
        "INSERT INTO campaign_moves (campaign_id, from_folder, to_folder) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
        (campaign_id, previous_folder_id, shared_folder_id),
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    requests.post(
        INVITE_API,
        json={"email": agency_email, "campaign": campaign_name, "role": role, "token": token},
        timeout=10,
    )
    return f"Granted {role} on '{campaign_name}' to {agency_email}, moved from folder {previous_folder_id} to {shared_folder_id}, invite expires {expires_at}"
